narrative.overview:
The approved homepage establishes a bright B2B furniture showroom: the supplied bronze raster logo, forest Manrope, complete furniture silhouettes and chalk, sage and quiet gray planes. Compact rectangular actions and restrained rules carry this identity through discovery, reading, configuration and a real inquiry.

The owner's latest 2026-10-12 instruction — “dabar pagal home page perdaryk stiliu visos likusios svetaines, kad jie sutaptu. Headeris, footeris, šriftai išdestymai ir visa kita” — extends this world to the remaining site. It supersedes the former homepage-only palette and retained inner pill rules. The approved homepage composition remains the root-route authority; inner layouts adapt the same world to their actual tasks. The [whole-site brief](.impeccable/surfaces/site-style.md) and [homepage brief](.impeccable/surfaces/src-app-page-tsx.md) own those surface contracts.

The owner's 2026-10-13 density refinement reduces information scale, spacing and visible controls across inner pages and establishes five catalog products per desktop row. The [inner-density brief](.impeccable/surfaces/inner-density.md) owns this scoped refinement; the approved homepage, shared header/footer and global defaults retain their values.

Earlier selected-01 and Framery/03 directions, the 2026-10-10 typography audit, homepage integration and footer release receipts remain historical evidence. Current local style checks and the separate finish review are in [.impeccable/review/site-style-20261012/](.impeccable/review/site-style-20261012/); this documentation does not certify a new public deployment.
keyCharacteristics: Supplied raster branding, forest Manrope and chalk/sage planes across public and operational routes.
4px actions and ordinary fields; straight image frames and genuine furniture silhouettes.
Clear page headings and task-specific catalog, product, quote and reading layouts.
One shared header using the original approved homepage geometry, raster logo, visible navigation and native search on every route.
One dark green footer with original contacts, protected links and lower-bar actions.
Approved homepage composition and local type exceptions retained independently.
Product photographs, material samples and user-selected 3D scenes preserve their visual truth.

rules.name: The Shared World Rule
rules.body: Use the forest/chalk/sage primitives and 4px actions throughout active inner templates. Preserve the approved homepage composition and its scoped text exceptions; do not restore the superseded inner palette or pill actions.

rules.name: The Furniture First Rule
rules.body: Keep complete product silhouettes on their documented source backgrounds and let real furniture supply the material color. Room visualizations do not establish an exact available configuration.

rules.name: The Text Role Rule
rules.body: Assign every new text style a role, family, size or fluid bounds, weight, leading, tracking, measure and contrast pairing before adding it. Reuse documented shared roles or intentional site-theme variants, then keep frontmatter, sidecar and source aligned. Shared supporting copy starts at 14px and ordinary entry stays 16px; the homepage-matched 15px header search and approved homepage exceptions are explicit roles. Header-quote and header-count frontmatter tokens remain historical, unused by the shared header.

rules.name: The Approved Type Override Rule
rules.body: Preserve the observed typography of the approved homepage inside .approved-home. Its px-based display, 12–13px notes, desktop 14px contact entry and local tracking remain scoped exceptions; palette and action geometry are now shared across the site.

rules.name: The Name Then Context Rule
rules.body: Put the model name first, then category/type, code and manufacturer context. Keep attribution below product headings and retain the source text case.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate UI surfaces with open space, tonal grounds and thin rules; keep cards and controls free of cast shadows.

rules.name: The Saved Means Saved Rule
rules.body: Show “Užklausa išsaugota.” and the first eight characters of the returned request ID only after a successful API response. Do not turn stored-request success into an email-delivery claim; SMTP remains unconfigured.

rules.name: The One Footer Rule
rules.body: Keep original contacts and protected legacy links in the single shared dark green footer; do not restore a second homepage contact/SEO band.

dos: Do extend the approved forest/chalk/sage identity to active inner templates through site-theme.css.
